Chat streaming against real OpenAI API, verifies chunks received

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"max_tokens\":50,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count from 1 to 5.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("OPENAI_API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.chatStream(req);
        System.out.println(result);
        }
    }
}
```
